selection_rule: The top 2 genes by BH-adjusted p on the enriched side (logFC > 0) of each prespecified CON-only anatomical contrast. Ties break on -|logFC| then gene symbol, so the pick is deterministic. Rows are then ordered by baseline CON peak unit.
selected_from: 11 prespecified CON-only anatomical contrasts, fitted on CON animals only
rule_used_the_displayed_result: no - the contrast set was fixed before any stress contrast was computed, and no stress group enters selection or row order
caveat: Descriptive characterisation of baseline spatial structure, not validation.

selection_rule: A written list of canonical compartment markers, 3-4 per compartment, each of which must then pass primary AND strict detection eligibility in its intended compartment or the build fails.
selected_from: curated canonical markers, gated by the detection-eligibility audit
rule_used_the_displayed_result: no - selection is recorded as not using observed cross-compartment direction or effect magnitude; expected direction is post-selection validation only
caveat: Chosen for recognisability, not for performance.

selection_rule: Every pairing declared an expected anatomical correspondence (CA1 to CA1, CA2/3 to CA2/3, target stratum to its own signature). Expectation is a property of anatomy, written before results.
selected_from: all 30 tested internal-contrast by external-signature pairings
universe_size: 10 of 30 expected; all 30 released in ST2
rule_used_the_displayed_result: no - expectation is declared from anatomy, not from the result
caveat: The one externally anchored panel in the package.

selection_rule: One GO term per anatomical contrast: the maximum |NES|, ties broken on term description.
selected_from: the canonical GO BP GSEA of each anatomical contrast
rule_used_the_displayed_result: yes - the term shown is the maximum of the quantity shown, within a prespecified contrast
caveat: Characterisation of the same proteomic data, explicitly NOT independent validation.

selection_rule: Themes flagged claim-eligible in a version-controlled registry, drawn in registry display order. Admission requires all five of biological coherence, recurrence across spatial contexts, distinctness from ontology ancestor ladders, non-QC status and material representation. Selection must never use SUS/RES direction, NES magnitude or the leading-edge proteins.
selected_from: all GO BP terms assigned to a registry theme
rule_used_the_displayed_result: no - ordering and admission are phenotype-independent; the rows are never sorted by NES, FDR, direction or support count
caveat: Descriptive aggregation. No theme-level p-value or FDR exists.

selection_rule: EDITORIAL. One FDR-supported program per compartment, fixed as a literal table, chosen to represent distinct biology in each of the three compartments. Not an algorithmic maximum. Chosen after the phenotype-contrast results were known.
selected_from: claim-eligible themes FDR-supported for SUS - RES within each compartment
universe_size: 51 of 64 FDR-supported claim-eligible terms in CA3_sr | 6 of 24 FDR-supported claim-eligible terms in CA2_sp | 3 of 22 FDR-supported claim-eligible terms in CA1
rule_used_the_displayed_result: yes - chosen after seeing the results, by judgement rather than by a rule
caveat: Illustrative, never 'strongest'. The complete evidence they illustrate is the atlas and the inventories released here.

selection_rule: The leading edge of the exemplar's own enrichment, ranked by |stored rank statistic|, top 7. The cut at 7 is a display constraint chosen for legibility, not a statistical threshold.
selected_from: the complete leading edge of the three exemplar terms, for SUS - RES
universe_size: 415 leading-edge memberships across the 3 exemplar terms (SUS - RES)
rule_used_the_displayed_result: yes - both the parent program and the within-program ranking are outcome-dependent
caveat: No protein is individually FDR-supported (smallest BH FDR 0.53). Not validated, not significant, not drivers.
complete_inventory_released_as: leading_edge_protein_inventory.csv + leading_edge_protein_recurrence.csv (membership and universe size only; the per-protein rank statistic that orders the top-7 cut is not carried - upstream supplies leading-edge genes alphabetically, so the displayed ordering cannot be reproduced from these tables)
